blurb: BlackBox Studios offers ballet and dance classes for kids and adults with various membership options and class cards. They provide private dance lessons in person or via Zoom. The studio also rents space for rehearsals, private lessons, and workshops, and offers choreographer residencies with free studio time and presentation opportunities.
extraNote: Monthly memberships billed the 1st of the month, cancel or change by emailing 48 hours prior to next billing cycle · Memberships can be paused one month per year free, additional holds $25 · No refunds on memberships cancelled late or mid cycle · Students not admitted to class after 10 minutes late · Free trial classes require registration and signed waivers
